shortDescription: Configures MAC address pools on Cisco UCS Manager

options.name: description
options.description: A description of the MAC pool. Enter up to 256 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote), = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), or ' (single quote).

options.name: first_addr
options.description: The first MAC address in the block of addresses. This is the From field in the UCS Manager MAC Blocks menu.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: last_addr
options.description: The last MAC address in the block of addresses. This is the To field in the UCS Manager Add MAC Blocks menu.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the MAC pool. This name can be between 1 and 32 alphanumeric characters. You cannot use spaces or any special characters other than - (hyphen), "_" (underscore), : (colon), and . (period). You cannot change this name after the MAC pool is created.

options.name: order
options.description: The Assignment Order field. This can be one of the following: default - Cisco UCS Manager selects a random identity from the pool. sequential - Cisco UCS Manager selects the lowest available identity from the pool.

options.name: org_dn
options.description: The distinguished name (dn) of the organization where the resource is assigned.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify MAC pool is present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify MAC pool is absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.
